text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, Today is the day of my 
big race. And it's also the day of 
Mifuyu-chan's important test."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"The two of us will get closer to our 
dreams together. And of course, to the one 
who told me 'I'll be waiting'—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live up to City-san's feelings 
too. So... we made a promise. That I'd run 
a race that makes me love myself!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"We'll carve our race, our dream, right 
here into history. That's our vow!"
